status.main_product: Pickles, spices, blended masalas, and cooking pastes
status.scope_reason: The company manufactures and processes blended spices, curry powders, and ready-to-cook spice mixes under its own brand 'Mother's Recipe'.
status.evidence: According to the company's official website, Desai Foods Private Limited manufactures and sells spices, curry powder, and blended spices under the Mother's Recipe brand.

claims.claim: The company reports strategic sourcing integration by participating as an investor in the ₹72 crore Pre-Series A funding round of KisanKonnect Safe Foods in February 2025, an omnichannel farm-to-fork startup that directly links smallholder farmer networks to urban food supply ecosystems.
claims.corrected: The company reports strategic sourcing integration by participating as an investor in the ₹72 crore Pre-Series B funding round of KisanKonnect Safe Foods in September 2025, an omnichannel farm-to-fork startup that directly links smallholder farmer networks to urban food supply ecosystems.
claims.source: LinkedIn Post by The CEO Magazine - India, https://www.linkedin.com/posts/the-ceo-magazine---india_kisankonnect-fundingnews-startupfunding-activity-7377258629252435968-kOMs; Inc42 Article, https://inc42.com/buzz/kisankonnect-nets-inr-72-cr-to-sell-fresh-fruits-vegetables/

claims.claim: The company reports robust supply chain compliance at its Sarole manufacturing facility in Maharashtra, which is registered with the Spice Board of India, the Export Inspection Council, and the US FDA, holding ISO 9001 and FSSC 22000 certifications.
claims.source: Mother's Recipe Official Corporate Website, https://www.mothersrecipe.com/pages/our-manufacturing-facilties

claims.claim: The company's corporate procurement operations manage the supply chain flow of over 60 raw materials and 100 packaging materials across a national network of 50 local vendors, utilizing localized development to reduce lead times and inventory excess.
claims.note: over 60 raw materials and 100 packaging materials across a national network of 50 local vendors, utilizing localized development to reduce lead times and inventory excess
claims.source: Google Search and Public Filings for Desai Foods Private Limited

claims.claim: The company reports under its Mother's Recipe brand a diversified portfolio spanning more than 12 Indian ethnic food categories with over 400 total SKUs, including regional spice blends, cooking pastes, and curry powders, according to a corporate report by Business India.
claims.source: Business India Corporate Report, https://businessindia.co/magazine/corporate-report/desai-foods-focus-on-local-and-regional-cuisines

claims.claim: The company reports that its dedicated Food Services division develops customized spice and flavor offerings tailored specifically to the requirements of B2B and HoReCa (Hotels, Restaurants, and Catering) customers, according to the official Mother's Recipe corporate website.
claims.source: Mother's Recipe Project Report document via Scribd, https://fr.scribd.com/document/808327725/Shraddha-food-project

claims.claim: The company's retail spice portfolio includes a catalog of 25 ready-to-cook region-specific spice mixes alongside 15 distinct blended spices such as Kasuri Methi, Fish Masala, Achari Chicken Masala, and Sambhar Masala, as verified by product listings on the Mother's Recipe e-commerce platform.
claims.source: https://mothersrecipe.com

claims.claim: The company reports that its Institutional Business segment develops tailored product formulations and custom bulk supplies to satisfy the criteria of specialized public clients including CSD canteens and the Indian Army, according to the company's official corporate overview page.
claims.source: https://www.mothersrecipe.com/pages/about

claims.claim: The company maintains private label operations for distinct spice products, as supported by an "Asafoetida Private Label Invitation" itemized in historical corporate portfolio handouts.
claims.corrected: The company maintains private label operations for distinct spice products, as supported by an "Asafoetida Private Label Invitation" itemized in historical corporate portfolio handouts.
claims.note: The "Asafoetida Private Label Invitation" belongs to Shubh Food Industries Pvt. Ltd., not Desai Foods Private Limited.
claims.source: https://www.scribd.com/document/547951512/Event-Invitation

claims.claim: The company reports that its Sarole manufacturing facility near Shirwal holds ISO 9001 and FSSC 22000 certifications, and is registered with the Spice Board of India, the Export Inspection Council, and the US FDA, as stated on its official website.
claims.source: https://www.mothersrecipe.com/pages/our-manufacturing-facilties

claims.claim: The company reports that its Bharoda manufacturing plant in Gujarat spans 1.8 Lakh square feet and utilizes cutting-edge automation to ensure precision and quality, according to a press release on The Print.
claims.source: https://theprint.in/ani-press-releases/desai-foods-mothers-recipe-is-recognized-as-gujarat-na-anmol-ratna/1685020/

claims.claim: The company reports that its Bharoda plant holds distinguished food safety and quality compliance certifications from the British Retail Consortium (BRC) and the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI), according to a corporate announcement on ANI News.
claims.source: ANI News press release republished on ThePrint titled 'Desai Foods - Mother's Recipe is Recognized as Gujarat Na Anmol Ratna'

claims.claim: Desai Foods expanded its regional spice portfolio under the Mother's Recipe brand by launching Achari Meat Masala and Madras Curry Powder tins.
claims.note: Launching Achari Meat Masala and Madras Curry Powder tins under Mother's Recipe regional spice portfolio could not be verified by any credible published source.
claims.source: Google Search

claims.claim: Desai Foods partners with LabelBlind to utilize its AI-driven SaaS platform, FolSol, which automates rule-based formulation validations, ingredient checks, and regulatory nutrition table compliance.
claims.source: YourStory article / LabelBlind Client portfolio overview

claims.claim: The company reports spending over 18 months developing and launching a new line of Ready-to-Cook Masalas, including specialized variants like Malvani Fish Fry, Puneapple Rasam, and Old Madras Sambar, crafted in collaboration with independent home chefs.

claims.claim: The company won the "Product of the Year" award in 2016 for product innovation within its food and spice portfolio.

claims.claim: The company reports a historical trajectory of growing at a compound annual growth rate (CAGR) of over 20 percent over a 10-year period.

claims.claim: In September 2026, the company's brand Mother's Recipe recorded a Buying Intent Index score of 3.87, ranking 9th out of 19 brands measured in the spices category, according to the India Buying Intent Index.
claims.note: The India Buying Intent Index score of 3.87 and ranking of 9th out of 19 brands for Mother's Recipe in September 2026 could not be confirmed in published sources.

claims.claim: The company reports that its Mother's Recipe products command domestic market shares varying from 20% to 30% across packaged ethnic food categories, including approximately 30% in branded pickles and 25% in cooking pastes, as documented by Business India.
claims.source: https://businessindia.co/magazine/corporate-report/desai-foods-focus-on-local-and-regional-cuisines

claims.claim: In the domestic branded packaged food segment, Mother's Recipe products hold a market share ranging between 20 per cent and 30 per cent across most of its categories, according to a report by Business India.
claims.source: https://businessindia.co/magazine/corporate-report/desai-foods-focus-on-local-and-regional-cuisines

claims.claim: In the branded cooking paste segment, the Mother's Recipe brand commands an estimated 25 per cent market share in India, according to a corporate analysis by Business India.
claims.source: https://businessindia.co/magazine/corporate-report/desai-foods-focus-on-local-and-regional-cuisines

claims.claim: The company has established a domestic distribution reach of 200,000 normal retail outlets across India, as published by Restaurant India in August 2026.

claims.source: Restaurant India website and digital archives

claims.claim: The company utilizes a multi-format channel network servicing mom-and-pop stores (general trade), modern trade outlets, multi-functional outlets, cash-and-carry stores, and defense canteens, as verified by Restaurant India in August 2026.

claims.source: MediaNews4U interview with Executive Director Sanjana Desai (August 2023)
